subject: Human Body
title: Cerebral Blood Flow
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Cerebral Blood Flow.

hook.text: Your brain gets 750 mL of blood per minute. Interrupt the flow for 5 seconds and you lose consciousness.

buildup.text: Four arteries supply the brain: two carotids in front and two vertebrals in back. They merge as a safety ring.

discovery.text: The Circle of Willis connects all four arteries. If one blocks, the others can reroute blood to compensate.

twist.text: The brain auto-regulates blood flow. Blood pressure can swing widely but cerebral flow stays remarkably constant.

climax.text: If auto-regulation fails during severe hypertension, fluid leaks into brain tissue. This is hypertensive encephalopathy.

punchline.text: Four arteries and a safety ring keep the brain fed. Always.

quiz.question: What is the Circle of Willis?
options: A ring that connects all brain arteries as a backup system
The area where brain tissue is thickest
A loop of veins that drains the brain
